scripts.lint:types: npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.build:chrome: npm run lint:types && cross-env TARGET=chrome vite build
scripts.build:firefox: npm run lint:types && cross-env TARGET=firefox FF_ADDON_ID=element-inspector@moyarich.local vite build
scripts.demo:gif: cross-env TARGET=chrome vite build --mode development && node demo/create-demo.mjs
scripts.demo:run: cross-env TARGET=chrome vite build --mode development && node demo/extension.smoke.mjs
scripts.demo:smoke: cross-env TARGET=chrome vite build --mode development && node demo/extension.smoke.mjs --ci
scripts.chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext run --source-dir dist --target chromium
scripts.firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist
